descriptionFull: The gray catbird ( Dumetella carolinensis ), also spelled grey catbird , is a medium-sized North American and Central American perching bird of the mimid family. It is the only member of the "catbird" genus Dumetella . Like the black catbird ( Melanoptila glabrirostris ), it is among the basal lineages of the Mimidae, probably a closer relative of the Caribbean thrasher and trembler assemblage than of the mockingbirds and Toxostoma thrashers. In some areas it is known as the slate-colored mockingbird .
